meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能通过gget命令/Python查询20多个生物数据库，例如查基因信息、做序列比对、下载基因组或预测蛋白质结构，并把结果整理成表格或文件返回。
howto.when: 当用户提到基因查询、序列比对/搜索、下载参考基因组或预测蛋白质结构等生物信息学任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段蛋白序列做BLAST比对
say.note: 会调用gget blast并显示匹配结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the gget CLI/Python tool to query 20+ bioinformatics databases, e.g., gene info, sequence alignment, genome downloads, and protein structure prediction, returning results as tables or files.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks about gene lookup, sequence alignment/search, reference genome download, or protein structure prediction (etc.).

say_en.note: Runs gget search and returns a gene list.

say_en.note: Calls gget blast and shows hits.
